notes: No options_test.ts exists in this upstream version; native NATSOptions.test.ts independently validates configuration before transport acquisition.
Private Servers, Heartbeat and protocol lifecycle observations map to public pool metadata, scoped Socket ownership, status streams and TestClock-controlled wire behavior.
Native Option.none replaces nullable server selection. Native explicit factory injection replaces global transport URL parser registration.
Upstream jitter case checks custom delay callback and private presence of a default function; native Schedule/Random delay law replaces that private representation.
Remote broker dependencies are replaced by isolated local integration brokers.
This artifact covers only these three upstream files.
